project_specification.overview: Integrates the full Idea Code design system extraction methodology into AutoForge's style pipeline. Users upload a screenshot of any website or UI, and the system extracts the complete Visual Design Language (color tokens, typography, component patterns, spacing rules, and Tailwind theme config) using Claude's vision capabilities. Extracted styles produce the same output format as predefined styles, so the coding agent can consume either interchangeably. Adds style classification to identify which of the 12 known design styles best matches the extracted aesthetic.

frontend.state_management: TanStack Query, React hooks and context

additional.vision_api: Claude Vision API for screenshot analysis
additional.testing: ruff (Python lint), npm run lint + npm run build (TypeScript)

prerequisites.environment_setup: - Python 3.11+ with existing AutoForge venv - Node.js 20+ for UI development - Existing AutoForge installation with all dependencies - Anthropic API key configured (for Claude Vision API calls) - Existing style_manager.py service with predefined styles

core_features.extraction_service: - Create server/services/style_extractor.py with the full Idea Code EXTRACTION_PROMPT constant that instructs Claude to extract abstract color tokens, typography system, component patterns, layout/spacing physics, Tailwind theme extension, and style classification from a screenshot image - Implement async extract_style_from_image(image_data, image_format) that sends the screenshot to Claude Vision API with the EXTRACTION_PROMPT and returns the raw markdown style guide response - Implement parse_extraction_result(raw_markdown) that parses the raw response into a structured StyleExtraction dataclass with fields for color_tokens, typography, component_patterns, layout_spacing, tailwind_theme, and style_classification
core_features.style_processing: - Generate a complete Tailwind CSS theme extend config via generate_tailwind_config(extraction) that converts extracted color tokens, typography, border radius, and shadows into the same format used by predefined styles - Classify extracted aesthetics via classify_style(extraction) against the 12 known style categories (Flat Design, Minimalism, Neumorphism, Glassmorphism, Skeuomorphism, Neubrutalism, Bauhaus, Claymorphism, Retro Futurism, Cyberpunk, Dark Mode Elegant, Warmer Shades) returning a primary style with confidence and optional accent style - Normalize extraction output via normalize_to_style_guide(extraction) into the same markdown format produced by predefined styles' get_style_guide_markdown(), ensuring sections 1-5 are structurally identical regardless of source
core_features.server_api: - Accept multipart image upload (PNG, JPG, WebP, max 10MB) at POST /api/styles/extract, run extraction through style_extractor, and return the structured StyleExtraction result with an extraction_id - Return saved extraction results via GET /api/styles/extractions (list with thumbnails) and GET /api/styles/extractions/{extraction_id} (full result with raw_markdown, structured data, tailwind_config, and classification) - Delete a saved extraction via DELETE /api/styles/extractions/{extraction_id} with 404 response for non-existent IDs
core_features.integration: - Accept an extraction_id in style_manager.py and load the extracted style guide as the active style for a project via POST /api/projects/{project_name}/style/apply-extraction, using the same code path as predefined style selection - Detect when a project uses an extracted style (vs predefined) in the agent prompt injection pipeline and inject the normalized style guide markdown using the same insertion point and format as predefined styles
core_features.ui_components: - Provide a screenshot upload component with drag-and-drop zone and file picker in the project creation flow and style settings, showing image preview before extraction triggers - Display extraction results in a preview component with parsed color tokens as labeled swatches, typography hierarchy samples, style classification with confidence badge, and Tailwind theme config in a code block - Apply an extracted style as the project's design system via an action button on the preview component, with a ConfirmModal when overwriting an existing style selection
core_features.error_handling: - Reject invalid image formats with 400 Bad Request and oversized images (>10MB) with 413 Payload Too Large, showing clear guidance on accepted formats and size limits - Handle Vision API failures by returning a user-friendly error with retry action, and handle malformed extraction output by falling back to raw markdown display with a warning toast

tables.style_extractions: - id (INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT) - image_filename (TEXT NOT NULL) - image_thumbnail (BLOB) - raw_markdown (TEXT NOT NULL) - color_tokens_json (TEXT NOT NULL) - typography_json (TEXT NOT NULL) - component_patterns_json (TEXT NOT NULL) - layout_spacing_json (TEXT NOT NULL) - tailwind_config_json (TEXT NOT NULL) - primary_style (TEXT) - primary_style_confidence (TEXT) - accent_style (TEXT) - accent_style_confidence (TEXT) - created_at (TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - updated_at (TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
tables.project_style_config: - id (INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT) - project_name (TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, references project registry by name) - style_type (TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK IN ('predefined', 'extracted')) - predefined_style_id (TEXT, name of predefined style when style_type is 'predefined') - extraction_id (INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY -> style_extractions.id, used when style_type is 'extracted') - created_at (TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - updated_at (TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

api_endpoints_summary.style_extraction: - POST /api/styles/extract (upload image, run extraction, return structured result) - GET /api/styles/extractions (list all saved extractions with thumbnails) - GET /api/styles/extractions/{extraction_id} (get full extraction result) - DELETE /api/styles/extractions/{extraction_id} (delete a saved extraction)
api_endpoints_summary.style_application: - POST /api/projects/{project_name}/style/apply-extraction (apply an extracted style to a project)

ui_layout.main_structure: - Existing AutoForge UI layout unchanged - Screenshot upload component embedded in project creation wizard (style selection step) - Screenshot upload also accessible from project settings (style section) - Extraction preview displays as a modal or expandable panel
ui_layout.extraction_preview_layout: - Header with image thumbnail, primary style badge, and extraction timestamp - Color section: grid of labeled color swatches (brand, surface, text, border, status) - Typography section: font family, hierarchy samples with size/weight - Components section: card/button/input pattern descriptions - Layout section: spacing base unit, density, radius rule - Tailwind config section: syntax-highlighted code block - Footer with Apply to Project button

design_system.color_palette: - Use existing AutoForge neobrutalism design system - Extraction-specific: use neutral grays for preview container so extracted colors stand out - Confidence badges: green for high, yellow for medium, red for low
design_system.typography: - Follow existing AutoForge typography - Code blocks for Tailwind config use monospace font
design_system.spacing: - Follow existing AutoForge spacing scale (4px base unit) - Color swatch grid uses gap-3 with consistent swatch size (w-12 h-12) - Preview panel sections use standard gap-4 vertical spacing - Upload zone uses generous padding (p-8) for clear drop target

ui_ux_standards.banned_patterns: - alert(), confirm(), prompt() - Use modals and toasts instead - Text-only empty states - Use EmptyState component with icon + CTA - Loading states that just say "Loading..." - Use skeleton loaders - Delete without confirmation - Always use ConfirmModal - Raw timestamps - Format as relative time
ui_ux_standards.required_components: - Use existing AutoForge UI components (Modal, ConfirmModal, Toast, Skeleton, EmptyState) - Drag-and-drop upload zone with file type validation - Color swatch display component - Confidence badge component
ui_ux_standards.page_patterns: - Upload triggers extraction inline (no page navigation) - Preview appears as modal or expandable panel after extraction - Apply action uses ConfirmModal before committing
ui_ux_standards.feedback_protocol: - Upload start: progress indicator on upload zone - Extraction running: skeleton loader in preview area with "Analyzing design..." message - Extraction complete: toast + preview populates with results - Extraction failed: error toast + retry button + keep uploaded image - Style applied: success toast + style indicator updates in project header

coding_standards.architecture: - Python: New service at server/services/style_extractor.py - Python: New router at server/routers/styles.py (or extend existing if applicable) - Python: Integration points in existing style_manager.py and prompts.py - TypeScript: Types in ui/src/lib/types.ts, API in ui/src/lib/api.ts, hooks in ui/src/hooks/ - TypeScript: Components in ui/src/components/ (upload, preview, swatches) - Follow existing patterns in each file - match code style and conventions
coding_standards.testing: - Python: ruff check . must pass - TypeScript: npm run lint and npm run build must pass - Extraction service testable with sample image fixtures
coding_standards.error_handling: - Vision API failures return user-friendly error with retry option - Invalid image formats rejected with clear message before upload - Parsing failures for malformed extraction output handled gracefully with raw markdown fallback - Large images (>10MB) rejected at upload with size guidance

key_interactions.extract_style_from_screenshot_flow: 1. User is in project creation wizard at style selection step 2. User sees predefined styles grid plus "Extract from Screenshot" option 3. User clicks Extract from Screenshot, sees drag-and-drop upload zone 4. User drops a PNG/JPG screenshot of a reference website or UI 5. Image preview appears, user confirms extraction 6. Skeleton loader displays "Analyzing design language..." 7. Claude Vision API processes image with Idea Code prompt 8. Extraction result populates: color swatches, typography, components, classification 9. User reviews extracted style guide with all sections 10. User clicks Apply to Project 11. ConfirmModal confirms the choice, style is set as project design system 12. Project creation continues with extracted style active
key_interactions.browse_saved_extractions_flow: 1. User navigates to project settings > Style section 2. User sees current style and "Change Style" option 3. User clicks "Browse Extracted Styles" to see previously saved extractions 4. Grid shows extraction thumbnails with primary style labels 5. User clicks an extraction to see full preview 6. User clicks Apply to switch the project to this style
key_interactions.coding_agent_style_consumption_flow: 1. Coding agent starts a new session for a project 2. Client.py detects project uses an extracted style (not predefined) 3. System loads normalized style guide markdown from style_extractions table 4. Style guide is injected into coding agent prompt at same insertion point as predefined styles 5. Agent receives identical format regardless of style source 6. Agent applies color tokens, typography, and component patterns during implementation

step.title: Style Processing Pipeline
step.tasks: - Implement generate_tailwind_config() from extracted tokens - Implement classify_style() against 12 known categories - Implement normalize_to_style_guide() for format parity with predefined styles

step.title: Database and API
step.tasks: - Add style_extractions table via SQLAlchemy model - Create server/routers/styles.py with extract, list, get, delete endpoints - Add apply-extraction endpoint for projects - Handle image upload with size and format validation

step.title: Integration with Existing Systems
step.tasks: - Connect extracted styles to style_manager.py pipeline - Add extracted style detection and prompt injection in client.py/prompts.py - Ensure coding agent receives identical format for extracted vs predefined styles

step.title: UI - Upload and Preview
step.tasks: - Build screenshot upload component with drag-and-drop and file picker - Build extraction preview component with color swatches, typography, classification - Build Apply to Project action with ConfirmModal - Add TypeScript types, API client functions, and React Query hooks

step.title: UI - Integration and Polish
step.tasks: - Integrate upload component into project creation wizard - Integrate into project settings style section - Add saved extractions browsing grid - Handle loading, error, and empty states

success_criteria.functionality: - Screenshot upload accepts PNG, JPG, WebP up to 10MB - Extraction produces structured color tokens, typography, components, layout, and Tailwind config - Style classification identifies primary and optional accent style with confidence - Extracted style guide markdown matches predefined style format (sections 1-5 identical) - Coding agent receives and applies extracted styles identically to predefined styles - Extractions persist in database and can be browsed, retrieved, and deleted
success_criteria.user_experience: - Upload zone provides clear drag-and-drop affordance - Extraction progress shows skeleton loader (not blank screen) - Color swatches clearly display extracted palette with semantic labels - Style classification shows confidence level visually - Apply action confirms before overwriting existing style - Errors show clear messages with retry option
success_criteria.technical_quality: - ruff check . passes with no errors - npm run lint and npm run build pass with no errors - No console errors in browser - All TypeScript types properly defined (no any) - Vision API errors handled gracefully with user-friendly messages - Image uploads validated for size and format before processing
